summary: Echofields is a React single-page app that lets users discover and view text-based “clues” via URL paths under /echofields (e.g., /echofields/1). It includes a separate admin portal at /echofields/admin intended for the site owner to create and delete clues. The frontend uses TanStack Router for routing, React Query for data fetching/mutations, and an Internet Identity (DFINITY AuthClient) provider for authentication. The backend is a Motoko canister with in-memory clue storage and a token-based access-control system that assigns the first properly-initialized caller as admin and others as users.

existing_features.title: Route-based navigation under /echofields with root redirect
existing_features.description: Defines TanStack Router routes for /echofields (Home), /echofields/$clueId (CluePage), and /echofields/admin (AdminPage), and redirects the root path / to /echofields via a Navigate component.

existing_features.title: Shared application layout with header and footer
existing_features.description: Wraps all pages in a shared layout component that renders a sticky header with an Echofields home navigation button and a footer with attribution.

existing_features.title: Public landing page with first-visit intro animation
existing_features.description: Implements a landing page at /echofields that shows a 3-second “Echofields” intro animation on first visit (tracked in sessionStorage), then displays feature cards and instructions without requiring login.

existing_features.title: Public clue viewing page with loading and not-found states
existing_features.description: Fetches a clue by URL parameter, shows skeletons while loading, and displays a not-found/invalid-ID error UI with navigation back to /echofields.

existing_features.title: Safe rich clue rendering with Markdown image support
existing_features.description: Parses clue text for Markdown image syntax ![alt](url) and renders text and images without allowing raw HTML. Image URLs are validated (http/https or relative) and broken images are hidden on error.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider and hook
existing_features.description: Provides a React context for Internet Identity using @dfinity/auth-client, including stored-identity initialization, login with configurable derivation origin, logout/clear, and granular status flags/errors.

existing_features.title: Identity-bound backend actor creation and access-control initialization
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous backend actor when logged out and an identity-bound actor when logged in. On authenticated actor creation, reads a secret (caffeineAdminToken) from the URL hash/session and calls _initializeAccessControlWithSecret, then invalidates/refetches other React Query queries when the actor changes.

existing_features.title: React Query data layer for clue operations
existing_features.description: Implements query/mutation hooks for listing clues, fetching a clue by ID, creating clues, and deleting clues through the backend actor, including query cache invalidation after mutations.

existing_features.title: Admin portal UI with Internet Identity login and owner allowlist gating
existing_features.description: Provides an admin portal at /echofields/admin that prompts for Internet Identity login, denies access unless the logged-in principal is in a local allowlist, and (when owner) exposes UI for creating and deleting clues with toasts and confirmation prompts plus an Edit/Preview tabbed editor.

existing_features.title: Secret URL parameter handling (hash + sessionStorage)
existing_features.description: Utilities to extract parameters from query or hash, persist them in sessionStorage, and securely handle secrets via hash-only parameters (getSecretParameter) that are removed from the address bar after extraction.

existing_features.title: Backend role-based access control with admin bootstrap token
existing_features.description: Implements a role system where the first principal to initialize with the correct token becomes #admin, others become #user, and anonymous is treated as #guest. Exposes helper methods (isAdmin, getUserRole, assignRole) and a mixin method (_initializeAccessControlWithSecret) that validates the token against CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN.

existing_features.title: Backend clue storage and CRUD APIs
existing_features.description: Stores clues in a Motoko Map keyed by incremental Nat IDs and exposes actor methods to create and delete clues (admin-only) and get/list clues (user-gated), with not-found errors implemented via Runtime.trap.

existing_features.title: Backend user profile storage and APIs
existing_features.description: Provides a simple UserProfile type and actor methods to get/save the caller’s profile and read other profiles with authorization checks (self or admin).

existing_features.title: Tailwind + shadcn/ui styling with dark mode and typography
existing_features.description: Uses Tailwind CSS with design tokens for light/dark themes (default dark), shadcn/ui components, and typography/animate plugins; includes CSS keyframes/utilities for the landing intro animation.

existing_features.title: Backend upgrade migration stub
existing_features.description: Includes a placeholder migration module (Migration.run) to support canister upgrades, currently returning an empty upgraded actor state.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update PPT clue display to use “Option 1” formatting/behavior (per user request).
Fix Admin portal authentication UI: add/restore a visible Internet Identity login button on /echofields/admin.
Apply a new visual style: use a Eurostile-style font, green color theme, and a fading/zooming animation for the Echofields branding/intro.
Expose newly added clues on the main site (e.g., show the first/latest clue as an option/link on the /echofields home page after creation).

architectural_notes: Frontend is a React SPA using TanStack Router with a shared layout and a hard redirect from / to /echofields.
Server interactions are encapsulated in @tanstack/react-query hooks (queries + mutations) with cache invalidation on successful mutations.
Internet Identity is integrated via a React context/provider wrapping @dfinity/auth-client and exposing login/logout plus status flags.
Backend actor creation is centralized in a hook (useActor) that switches between anonymous and identity-bound actors and forces query refresh when the actor changes.

Admin privilege bootstrap uses a shared Motoko mixin: frontend passes a secret (hash/session) to _initializeAccessControlWithSecret, which is validated against a canister env var (CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN).
Motoko authorization is role-based (#admin/#user/#guest) and enforced with Runtime.trap on unauthorized access.
Clues are stored in-memory in a Motoko Map with incremental Nat IDs; backend exposes create/get/list/delete APIs.
Clue rendering intentionally avoids raw HTML: a custom RichClueContent parser only supports Markdown image syntax and validates URL schemes.
UI is built with Tailwind + shadcn/ui components, next-themes (dark by default), and @tailwindcss/typography for prose styling.
Sensitive URL secrets are handled via hash-fragment extraction and sessionStorage persistence, with URL cleanup via history.replaceState.
known_issues: Backend clue APIs (getClue/listClues) require the caller to have #user permission, but the frontend is designed to allow public (logged-out) clue viewing; anonymous callers will likely trap with "User is not registered"/unauthorized unless backend policy changes.
AdminPage owner allowlist (OWNER_PRINCIPALS) is empty by default, so all logged-in principals will be denied until configured at build time.
Admin access is gated twice (frontend allowlist + backend token-based admin assignment); these can conflict and create confusing failure modes.
listClues returns only [Text] without IDs; the admin UI infers IDs from array index (index+1), which is unreliable (Map value order is not guaranteed, and deletions create holes).
If CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN is not set in the canister environment, _initializeAccessControlWithSecret traps, preventing authenticated actor initialization.
If the first authenticated user initializes with the wrong token, they are stored as #user and cannot be promoted later (assignRole is admin-only), potentially locking out admin creation.
Clues and userProfiles are not stored in stable variables; state will be lost on canister upgrade/reinstall (migration.mo is effectively a stub).
RichClueContent allows relative image URLs starting with '/', which may be undesirable depending on hosting/trust assumptions for embedded content.
React Query invalidation/refetch on actor changes is broad (all non-actor queries), which may cause bursts of network calls and UI churn on login/logout.
Clue IDs are parsed with parseInt in the route (CluePage); very large IDs or non-decimal inputs are not supported and will be treated as invalid.
